transcript.label: Academic article
transcript.name: Academic article

transcript.definition: Gives an impersonal explanatory overview that defines a subject and organizes established background, distinctions, or context for a general reader. A bare definition or a neutral tone alone is insufficient.
transcript.label: Encyclopedia entry
transcript.name: Encyclopedia entry

transcript.definition: Uses an organizational voice to announce, coordinate, or account for priorities, decisions, deliverables, responsibilities, or stakeholder expectations. Any workplace subject or polite prose is insufficient.
transcript.label: Corporate communication
transcript.name: Corporate communication

transcript.definition: Addresses a recipient service problem by acknowledging their difficulty and offering an actionable remedy, clarification, or next support step. Politeness or general willingness to help alone is insufficient.
transcript.label: Customer support reply
transcript.name: Customer support reply

transcript.definition: Presents a concrete event or development with attributed or situated factual details, distinguishing what happened from reported claims in a journalistic register. Discussing current affairs or sounding factual alone is insufficient.
transcript.label: News reporting
transcript.name: News reporting

transcript.definition: Organizes the passage to persuade an audience to adopt, buy, subscribe to, or favor something through a value proposition, appeal, or call to action. Enthusiasm or a favorable description alone is insufficient.
transcript.label: Promotional copy
transcript.name: Promotional copy

transcript.definition: Encourages personal action or persistence by reframing difficulty, affirming capacity, or offering a practical orientation toward improvement. Positive sentiment or any advice alone is insufficient.
transcript.label: Motivational advice
transcript.name: Motivational advice

transcript.definition: Invites or enacts sustained attention to present experience, perception, or the relation between observer and observed, using reflective or experiential exposition. Mentioning consciousness, meditation, or religion without this reflective operation is insufficient.
transcript.label: Contemplative reflection
transcript.name: Contemplative reflection

interpretation: Development screen, 48 one-per-lineage transcript targets and 12 separate synthetic controls. Wording changes are paired descriptive comparisons, not accuracy improvements, population prevalence or isolated stylistic effects.
